mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a thermal decomposition of fuel in the absence of air."
Pyrolysis is a thermal decomposition of fuel in the absence of air.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for many things-depending on what grade they were recycled from."
Glass is used for many things-depending on what grade they were recycled from.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered hazardous due to the potential for them to contain large volumes of hazardous materials and therefore, appropriate safety protocols must be followed."
Sampling tanks is considered hazardous due to the potential for them to contain large volumes of hazardous materials and therefore, appropriate safety protocols must be followed.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reaction between the fuel and oxidant (steam and oxygen) carried out in a restricted supply of oxygen so that complete combustion of the fuel does not take place."
Gasification is a reaction between the fuel and oxidant (steam and oxygen) carried out in a restricted supply of oxygen so that complete combustion of the fuel does not take place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the collection, transport, processing or disposal, managing and monitoring of solid waste materials."
Solid waste management is the collection, transport, processing or disposal, managing and monitoring of solid waste materials.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as "systematically reducing waste at source"."
Waste minimisation can be defined as "systematically reducing waste at source".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of destroying waste materials by burning it within the temperature range of 9000C - 12000C."
Incineration is the process of destroying waste materials by burning it within the temperature range of 9000C - 12000C.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the garbage that we produce in our homes and where we work."
Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) is the garbage that we produce in our homes and where we work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the garbage and rubbish."
Refuse is made up of the garbage and rubbish.

anaerobic process
